question: Will the temperature hit 15°C in New York City on Oct 18, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the observed temperature at the Central Park / New York City official weather station reaches or exceeds 15°C (59°F) at any recorded observation strictly after 2026-10-18T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-19T04:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if no recorded observation at the Central Park / New York City official weather station shows a temperature of 15°C (59°F) or higher during the window strictly after 2026-10-18T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-19T04:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- The reference station is the NOAA/NWS Cooperative Station at Central Park, New York City (the primary official surface observation point for NYC). If Central Park data are unavailable, the LaGuardia Airport (KLGA) ASOS station is used as the next-best official NYC observation point.
- A temperature "reaches 15°C" means at least one hourly or sub-hourly recorded observation within the window equals or exceeds 15.0°C (59.0°F); the daily high temperature reported for Oct 18, 2026 (local time) is also acceptable as a confirmatory measure.
